patterns.note: Content sections frequently alternate between full-width layouts and structured two-column or card-grid arrangements, often with distinct background colors for visual separation.
A single friendly, rounded sans-serif font is used consistently across all text, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy with large, inviting headings and legible body text.

A core neutral palette of white and light beige is consistently punctuated by vibrant, optimistic accent colors (yellow, blue, orange, green) used for illustrations, calls to action, and key highlights.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience. A sticky header remains visible at the top, and a promotional banner appears on initial scroll.
Key features and testimonials are presented within distinct, rounded-corner cards, often arranged in grids, making information digestible and visually appealing.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring primary navigation is always accessible. Additionally, a promotional banner should appear from the top on scroll and stick.

Utilize scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging a library like GSAP or an Intersection Observer API, to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in and a slight upward slide effect as they become visible in the viewport.

Integrate Lottie animations for decorative and illustrative elements throughout the page. These animations should play as their respective sections enter the viewport or on page load, adding a dynamic and playful character to the design.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, friendly sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, supported by legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners on all interactive elements, content cards, and image containers, creating a soft and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to readability and a clean aesthetic.

standout: The site's distinctive use of cheerful, simple, and often animated (Lottie) illustrations, combined with a vibrant, optimistic color palette, creates a uniquely friendly and approachable feel for a mental wellness platform, avoiding clinical or overly serious tones. If a builder copied only one idea from this site, it should be the integration of playful, branded Lottie animations to convey a lighthearted and supportive mood.
